Best Breakfast in Da Nang
Oct 2023 • Solo
I walked by this place several times, since I was staying nearby. I thought it looked pretty neat, and just like the Diners I have seen in the USA. I didn't go in right away because I wanted to try and eat Vietnamese food, while in Da Nang. One morning I was really hankering for a good ole American breakfast, and boy, they did not disappoint! The food was excellent, I had the biscuits and Gravy. and a yogurt fruit dish. It was really really good, and I wanted to eat more, but was able to control myself. The staff was very nice and prompt with their service. The place is very clean, and better than anyplace I can remember in the States. The owner, Scott, came in and sat with me for a little while, and we had a real nice conversation. I will be back next time I am in Da Nang, my only regret was that I didn't stop in sooner. Thank you all, for the great dining experience!!
